definition_zh: 考古解释；依据物质遗存还原过去生活与意义的系统解读
definition_en: the systematic reading of material traces in order to explain past behaviour and meaning
core_image: 散落的陶片、灰坑与地层剖面被一条推理链重新串成一段可讲述的日常生活
scene: 探方清理完毕，学生把陶片、灰坑与炭屑逐层登记，再让三者互相印证。The archaeological interpretation of the burnt layer rests on three independent lines of evidence.
sceneCN: 这里「考古解释」指依据物质遗存推断过去生活的系统解读（第 1 个义项：作为整体实践）；句意为对这一烧结层的考古解释建立在三条独立证据之上。

pos.zh: 考古解释（可数，指一项具体解读；亦可作不可数，指这类工作整体）

derivatives.zh: archaeo-（希腊 arkhaios「古老的」）+ -logy（希腊 -logia「学问」）→ 考古学：对古物的系统研究
archaeology + -ist（从事者）→ 考古学家
拉丁 interpretari（解释、翻译）+ 英语动词化 → 解释；口译
interpret + -ation（动作或结果）→ 解释；解读
interpret + -ive（属性后缀）→ 解释性的
re-（重新）+ interpret → 重新解释（语义偏移：换一套框架重读旧证据）
mis-（错误）+ interpret → 误读（语义偏移：把证据读成它不支持的意思）

senses.title: The discipline at work
senses.titleCN: 作为整体实践：从遗存读出过去
senses.definition: the whole practice of drawing explanations about past life from material remains
senses.definitionCN: 从物质遗存中推断过去生活状况的整体工作
senses.example: The archaeological interpretation of the burnt layer rests on three independent lines of evidence.
senses.exampleCN: 对这一烧结层的考古解释建立在三条独立证据之上。
senses.why: archaeo- comes from Greek arkhaios 'ancient', itself from arkhe 'beginning'; -logy is Greek -logia 'account, study'. Interpretation adds Latin interpres, the go-between who explains one party to another, so the phrase names the reasoned account that carries mute objects into words.
senses.whyCN: archaeo- 出自希腊 arkhaios「古老的」，其根为 arkhē「开端」；-logy 出自希腊 -logia「叙述、学问」。interpretation 又带来拉丁 interpres「居中传话者」的意思，因此整个短语指把沉默的物件翻译成人话的有据叙述。

senses.title: One stated reading of a site
senses.titleCN: 一项具体的解读：针对某遗址或某批遗存
senses.definition: a single explanation offered for one site, layer or group of finds
senses.definitionCN: 针对某一遗址、地层或一组出土物提出的具体解释
senses.example: Her archaeological interpretation of the pits as storage cellars was later challenged.
senses.exampleCN: 她把这些坑解释为储粮窖的考古解读后来受到质疑。
senses.why: This is the countable use: each reading is one answer put forward, and the phrase keeps the whole apparatus of evidence behind it.
senses.whyCN: 这是可数用法：每一种读法都是提出的一个答案，而短语仍带着背后整套证据的分量。

senses.title: Reading the layers
senses.titleCN: 读地层：按堆积顺序与相互关系判断先后
senses.definition: reading the order and mutual relations of deposits to establish sequence
senses.definitionCN: 通过堆积的顺序与相互关系确定时间先后
senses.example: The archaeological interpretation began with the section drawing, not with the artefacts.
senses.exampleCN: 这项考古解释从剖面图开始，而不是从器物开始。
senses.why: Stratum is Latin for a spread-out bed; because every layer buries what lies beneath it, the order of the layers is itself a clock, and reading a clock is the first act of interpretation.
senses.whyCN: stratum 在拉丁语里是「铺开的一层」；每一层都压住下面一层，因此层的顺序本身就是一只钟，读钟就是解释的第一步。

senses.title: Reading what happened after burial
senses.titleCN: 读埋藏后的经历：遗存如何被扰动、搬运、保存
senses.definition: reconstructing what happened to remains after they were deposited
senses.definitionCN: 重建遗存堆积之后所经历的扰动、搬运与保存过程
senses.example: Their archaeological interpretation treats the missing skull as a product of later disturbance.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的考古解释把头骨的缺失视为后期扰动的结果。
senses.why: Greek taphos 'burial' plus nomos 'law' gives taphonomy, the study of what burial does to a body or an object; interpretation must subtract that history before it can speak of the past.
senses.whyCN: 希腊 taphos「埋葬」加 nomos「法则」构成埋藏学，研究埋葬对遗体或器物做了什么；解释必须先扣掉这段经历，才能谈过去。

senses.title: Reading function
senses.titleCN: 读功能：推断器物曾经用来做什么
senses.definition: inferring from form, wear and context what an object was used for
senses.definitionCN: 由形制、使用痕迹与共存关系推断器物的用途
senses.example: Microwear on the blades supports an archaeological interpretation of them as sickles.
senses.exampleCN: 刀片上的微痕支持把它们解释为镰刀的考古解读。
senses.why: Function is the plainest thing a tool can be asked about: shape limits what a hand could do with it, and wear records what hands actually did.
senses.whyCN: 功能是工具最容易被追问的一件事：形状限定了手能拿它做什么，使用痕迹则记录了手实际做了什么。

senses.title: Reading society and meaning
senses.titleCN: 读社会与意义：身份、仪式与观念
senses.definition: inferring status, ritual and symbolic meaning from the arrangement of finds
senses.definitionCN: 由遗存的布置推断身份、仪式与象征意义
senses.example: An archaeological interpretation of the grave goods reads the imported beads as a claim to status.
senses.exampleCN: 对随葬品的考古解释把外来珠子读作对身份的宣告。
senses.why: Once function is settled, the same objects can be asked what they said: a bead far from its source is evidence of a trade route and of a person who wanted to be seen with it.
senses.whyCN: 功能确定之后，同一批物件还能被追问「它们说了什么」：一颗远离产地的珠子既证明贸易路线，也证明有人愿意戴着它被看见。

senses.title: The assembled narrative
senses.titleCN: 拼合的整体叙述：把零散证据写成一段生活
senses.definition: the coherent account of a settlement's life built from many separate readings
senses.definitionCN: 由许多单项解读拼成的、关于某聚落生活的连贯叙述
senses.example: The final archaeological interpretation describes a seasonal camp rather than a permanent village.
senses.exampleCN: 最终的考古解释描述的是一处季节性营地，而非永久村落。
senses.why: A narrative is what happens when single readings are set beside one another until they form a story; interpretation at this scale is composition, not a single inference.
senses.whyCN: 把单项解读彼此并置，直到它们成为一个故事，这就是叙述；这一层面的解释是「组稿」，而非一次单独推断。

senses.title: A rival reading
senses.titleCN: 修正性的对立解读：用新证据改写旧结论
senses.definition: a revised reading that replaces an earlier one after new evidence or new theory
senses.definitionCN: 因新证据或新理论而取代旧结论的修正读法
senses.example: The current archaeological interpretation reverses the earlier claim about who built the wall.
senses.exampleCN: 当前的考古解释推翻了早先关于谁修筑这道墙的说法。
senses.why: Interpres also meant a negotiator between two sides; when two readings negotiate, the older one does not vanish, it is recorded as superseded, which is why revision is itself a sense of the phrase.
senses.whyCN: interpres 也曾指居间谈判者；当两种读法谈判时，旧的并不消失，而是被记为已被取代——修正本身因此也是一个义项。

intro.en: Archaeological interpretation joins a Greek word for the study of ancient things to a Latin word for the act of explaining. The Greek deeper layer is only partly settled, and the second element of the Latin noun is openly disputed.
intro.cn: 「考古解释」把希腊语的「古物之学」与拉丁语的「解释之举」接在一起。希腊语更深一层只有部分定论，拉丁名词的第二个成分则公认有争议。

items.en: Arkhaios 'ancient, primitive' is formed on arkhe 'beginning, first cause', which comes from arkhein 'to begin, to rule'. The further Indo-European origin of arkhein is not established, and forms offered for it are reconstructions.
items.cn: arkhaios「古老的、原初的」由 arkhē「开端、首要原因」构成，而 arkhē 来自 arkhein「开始、统治」。arkhein 更早的印欧来源未定，凡为其拟出的形式都属重构。

items.en: -Logia 'account, study' derives from logos 'word, speech, reason', built on legein 'to gather, to say'. The common Indo-European root behind legein is a reconstruction, not a recorded form.
items.cn: -logia「叙述、学问」出自 logos「言词、理性」，后者由 legein「收集、说出」构成。legein 背后的印欧共同词根是重构，而非有记录的形式。

items.en: Interpres, interpretis meant 'go-between, negotiator, explainer'. It is built on inter 'between' plus an element of uncertain origin, sometimes linked to pretium 'price'; that link is a hypothesis, not a demonstrated derivation.
items.cn: interpres 意为「居间者、谈判者、解释者」，由 inter「在……之间」加一个来源不明的成分构成，该成分有时被联系到 pretium「价格」；这一联系只是假说，并非已证实的派生。

items.en: Interpretatio 'explanation, translation, exposition' is the action noun of interpretari, the verb built on interpres. English took it through Old French at the end of the Middle Ages.
items.cn: interpretatio「解释、翻译、阐发」是动词 interpretari 的行为名词，而 interpretari 由 interpres 构成。英语经古法语在中世纪末吸收该词。

items.en: Archaeology entered English in the seventeenth century as a word for the description of antiquities, and only in the nineteenth century became a field with its own methods; the exact phrase archaeological interpretation belongs mostly to twentieth-century practice.
items.cn: archaeology 于 17 世纪进入英语，指对古物的描述，到 19 世纪才成为有自身方法的学科；「考古解释」这一确切搭配大体属 20 世纪的实践语言。

items.en: Source uncertain: no fixed first citation exists for the exact phrase, the second element of interpres has no agreed origin, and every Indo-European form proposed for arkhein is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定：这一确切短语没有公认的最早书证；interpres 的第二成分没有一致来源；凡为 arkhein 拟出的印欧形式均为重构。

note.en: Group one holds the archaeological terms that are routinely mistaken for the interpretation itself; group two holds the general words for a reading or an account.
note.cn: 第一组是常被误当成「解释本身」的考古术语；第二组是泛指「读法、说法」的普通词。

entries.definition: The discipline that produces interpretations; it is the workshop, while an interpretation is one thing made in it.
entries.definitionCN: 产生各种解释的学科；它是作坊，而某项解释只是作坊里的一件成品。

entries.definition: The surviving material traces taken as a whole; it is what gets read, not what the reading says.
entries.definitionCN: 留存下来的物质遗存总体；它是被读的对象，而非读出的结论。

entries.definition: The formal publication of what was found and how; it carries interpretations but is not one.
entries.definitionCN: 正式发表出土物及其发掘过程的文献；它承载解释，但本身不是解释。

entries.definition: The study of layer order; it supplies the sequence that any interpretation must respect.
entries.definitionCN: 研究地层顺序的学问；它提供任何解释都必须遵守的先后次序。

entries.definition: Any act of assigning meaning to signs; it is the everyday counterpart of interpretation.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指对符号赋予意义的行为；是 interpretation 的日常说法。

entries.definition: A statement that makes something intelligible, often by giving a cause; an interpretation may explain, but it reads meaning.
entries.definitionCN: 使某事变得可理解的陈述，常给出原因；解释可以说明，但 interpretation 侧重读出意义。

entries.definition: A proposition put forward for testing; an interpretation is broader and need not be framed as a test.
entries.definitionCN: 为接受检验而提出的命题；interpretation 范围更广，未必写成可检验的形式。

entries.definition: An ordered account of events; an interpretation becomes a narrative when readings are composed into a story.
entries.definitionCN: 对事件的有序叙述；当多项解读被组成故事时，interpretation 就成了 narrative。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: arkhaios 'ancient' + -logia 'study': the reasoned account of ancient things.
normal.cn: arkhaios「古老」+ -logia「学问」：关于古物的有理据叙述。

normal.en: interpres is the go-between, so interpretation is the act of carrying a mute object's message across to a reader.
normal.cn: interpres 是居间传话者，因此解释就是把沉默物件的讯息运到读者这一边。

normal.en: The family runs archaeology, archaeologist, interpret, interpretation, interpretive, reinterpret, misinterpret.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 archaeology、archaeologist、interpret、interpretation、interpretive、reinterpret、misinterpret。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the work: interpretation of the site, competing interpretations, revise an interpretation.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出这项工作：对遗址的解释、相互竞争的解释、修正一项解释。

normal.en: Fieldwork order: layer, then disturbance, then function, then meaning, then a written account.
normal.cn: 田野里的顺序：先看层，再看扰动，再看功能，再看意义，最后写成文。

abstract.en: Picture an interpreter standing at a checkpoint between a heap of broken pots and a room of living readers.
abstract.cn: 想象一位译员站在关卡上，一边是碎陶堆，一边是活着的读者。

abstract.en: Picture a section drawing in which each coloured band is a sentence of a very slow book.
abstract.cn: 想象一张剖面图上每条色带都是一本极慢的书里的一句话。

abstract.en: Picture two maps of the same mound pinned side by side, each claiming to be the true one.
abstract.cn: 想象同一座土丘的两张图并排钉着，各自声称自己才是真的。

examples.en: Three teams produced the same archaeological interpretation of the walls from different evidence.
examples.cn: 三个团队从不同证据得出了相同的城墙考古解释。

examples.en: The archaeological interpretation of a single bead can carry a whole argument about trade.
examples.cn: 对一颗珠子的考古解释可以承载整套关于贸易的论证。

examples.en: Good practice states the archaeological interpretation separately from the evidence that supports it.
examples.cn: 规范的做法是把考古解释与支持它的证据分开陈述。

dict_mnemonic.text: archaeo（古老）+ logy（学问）+ interpretation（解释）＝ 把古物翻译成人话；记「先排队（地层），再看功能，最后谈意义」。

root: 考古：希腊 arkhaios「古老的」（源自 arkhē「开端」）+ -logia「学问、叙述」；解释：拉丁 interpretatio，来自 interpres「居中传话者」，其第二成分来源不确定，与 pretium「价格」的联系仅为假说。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one move: mute traces are put back into a context, asked what they did, asked what they meant, and finally argued over in writing.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个动作展开：把沉默的遗存放回情境，先问它做过什么，再问它意味着什么，最后落成文字并接受争论。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a broken pot, a hearth and a layer of ash are linked by one chain of reasoning into a day that can be told.
core.cn: 核心意象：碎陶、灶坑与一层灰被一条推理链连成一个可以讲述的日子。

branches.en: THE READING ITSELF: the practice as a whole, then one stated answer about one site.
branches.cn: 读法本身：先是整体工作，再是针对某遗址给出的一个答案。

branches.en: THE CLOCK: layer order turns a pile into a sequence before anything else can be said.
branches.cn: 时钟：地层顺序先把一堆东西变成有先后的序列，别的判断才谈得上。

branches.en: THE AFTERLIFE OF EVIDENCE: disturbance and decay must be subtracted before the past speaks.
branches.cn: 证据的来世：必须先扣掉扰动与腐朽，过去才开口。

branches.en: WHAT IT DID, THEN WHAT IT SAID: use-wear first, status and ritual afterwards.
branches.cn: 先做过什么，再说过什么：先看使用痕迹，后谈身份与仪式。

branches.en: COMPOSITION AND REVISION: single readings become a story, and a story can be replaced by a rival one.
branches.cn: 组稿与改写：单项解读合成故事，故事又会被对立的一版取代。

intro.en: The phrase is built from a Greek prefix-root pair and a Latin verb family, so both halves can be read morpheme by morpheme.
intro.cn: 这个短语由希腊语的前缀与词根、以及拉丁语动词词族两部分构成，两半都可按语素读出。

latinIntro.en: Greek arkhaios and -logia supply the first word; Latin interpres and interpretatio supply the second, and the Latin family is the larger one in English.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊 arkhaios 与 -logia 提供第一个词；拉丁 interpres 与 interpretatio 提供第二个词，而拉丁词族在英语中更庞大。

items.example: The archaeo- element appears in archaeology and archaeometry.
items.exampleCN: archaeo- 这一成分出现在 archaeology 与 archaeometry 中。

items.example: The suffix also builds biology and geology.
items.exampleCN: 同一后缀还构成 biology 与 geology。

items.meaning: the study of ancient material remains
items.meaningCN: 考古学：研究古代物质遗存
items.example: Archaeology supplies the evidence that the phrase reads.
items.exampleCN: 考古学提供这个短语所读的证据。

items.meaningCN: 考古学的；属于该学科的
items.example: The adjective marks the kind of interpretation being offered.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词限定解释的类别。

items.example: The Latin noun names the person who carries a message across.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁名词指把讯息运过边界的人。

items.example: Scholars interpret the same layer in different ways.
items.exampleCN: 学者们以不同方式解释同一层位。

items.meaning: the act or result of explaining
items.example: The written interpretation is kept apart from the raw finds.
items.exampleCN: 成文的解释与原始出土物分开保存。

items.example: The interpretive text hangs beside the display case.
items.exampleCN: 解释性文字挂在展柜旁。

items.meaning: to explain again in a new frame
items.example: Later scholars reinterpret the same walls as a boundary ditch.
items.exampleCN: 后来的学者把这些墙重新解释为界沟。

latinEntries.structure: archaeologia, -ae (New Latin, f., first declension, from Greek)

definition_zh: 人类学；对人类的社会、文化与生物演化的比较研究
definition_en: the comparative study of human societies, cultures and biological evolution
core_image: 一张桌子上并排放着三样东西：一本田野笔记、一副头骨模型和一段录音，四门分支各自从其中一样出发
scene: 课桌上一本田野笔记挨着一副头骨模型，学生第一次意识到这两样东西属于同一门课。She chose anthropology because the subject let her set a fishing village beside a desert town and ask what both call a family.
sceneCN: 这里「人类学」指对人类社会与文化作比较研究的学科（第 2 个义项：社会文化人类学）；句意为她选择人类学，是因为这门学问能让她把一个渔村与一座沙漠小镇并置，追问两者各自把什么叫作家庭。

pos.zh: 人类学（学科名，通常不可数；复数 anthropologies 指不同传统或不同领域的人类学研究）

forms.label: 复数（不同传统的人类学）

derivatives.zh: anthropology + -ical（关系形容词后缀）→ 人类学的
anthropology + -ist（从事者）→ 人类学家
anthropo-（希腊 anthrōpos「人」）+ -oid（形似）→ 类人的；类人猿
anthropo- + centr-（希腊 kentron「中心」）+ -ic → 以人类为中心的
phil-（希腊 philos「爱」）+ anthrōpos「人」+ -y → 博爱；慈善（语义偏移：爱人类之心）
mis-（希腊 misein「恨」）+ anthrōpos「人」+ -y → 厌世；憎人
anthropo- + -metry（希腊 metron「量」）→ 人体测量（语义偏移：把人当作可测对象）

senses.title: The discipline as a whole
senses.titleCN: 作为整体学科：研究人的一切方面
senses.definition: the broad study of human beings, their societies, cultures and biology
senses.definitionCN: 对人类及其社会、文化与生物属性的总体研究
senses.example: She chose anthropology because the subject let her set a fishing village beside a desert town and ask what both call a family.
senses.exampleCN: 她选择人类学，是因为这门学问能让她把一个渔村与沙漠小镇并置，追问两者各自把什么叫作家庭。
senses.why: Greek anthropos means 'human being' and -logia means 'account, study'; the word therefore claims the whole account of humans, which is why it is the widest of the social sciences.
senses.whyCN: 希腊 anthropos 意为「人」，-logia 意为「叙述、学问」；这个词因此自称包揽关于人的全部叙述，这也是它成为最宽的社会科学的原因。

senses.title: Social and cultural anthropology
senses.titleCN: 社会文化人类学：以田野方式比较社会生活
senses.definition: the branch that studies social life and culture through long-term field contact
senses.definitionCN: 通过长期田野接触研究社会生活与文化的那一分支
senses.example: Social anthropology in her department concentrated on kinship and ritual.
senses.exampleCN: 她所在系的社会人类学专注亲属关系与仪式。
senses.why: The unity of the broad word split into branches: one branch took society, another took culture, and both kept the comparison of whole ways of life as their method.
senses.whyCN: 宽泛的词内部分成诸分支：一支取社会，一支取文化，两枝都保留「比较整全生活方式」的方法。

senses.title: Biological anthropology
senses.titleCN: 生物人类学：研究人的体质、演化与差异
senses.definition: the branch that studies human biology, evolution and physical variation
senses.definitionCN: 研究人类生物学、演化与体质差异的分支
senses.example: Biological anthropology measures growth, genetics and fossil bones.
senses.exampleCN: 生物人类学测量生长、遗传与化石骨骼。
senses.why: The same word covers the body as well as the culture: humans are primates with a fossil record, so the account of humans must include bones and genes.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词既覆盖文化也覆盖身体：人类是有化石记录的灵长类，因此关于人的叙述必须包含骨骼与基因。

senses.title: Archaeology inside the four-field tradition
senses.titleCN: 四分支传统中的考古学
senses.definition: the study of past human life through material remains, treated as one of four fields
senses.definitionCN: 把通过物质遗存研究过去人类生活，作为四大分支之一
senses.example: In the four-field system, archaeology sits inside anthropology rather than beside it.
senses.exampleCN: 在四分支体系里，考古学处在人类学内部，而不是旁边。
senses.why: American anthropology assembled four fields around one object, the human being past and present; the material record was admitted because it is the only evidence for the deeper past.
senses.whyCN: 美国人类学围绕同一个对象——过去与现在的人——组装出四个分支；物质记录之所以被纳入，是因为它是更深过去唯一的证据。

senses.title: Linguistic anthropology
senses.titleCN: 语言人类学：语言在社会生活中的位置
senses.definition: the branch that studies language as social practice and cultural inheritance
senses.definitionCN: 把语言作为社会实践与文化传承来研究的分支
senses.example: Linguistic anthropology asks how a pronoun can mark kinship as well as number.
senses.exampleCN: 语言人类学追问一个代词如何既能标记亲缘又能标记数。
senses.why: Speech is human behaviour and human inheritance at once, so it could be claimed by the same account that claims kinship and tools.
senses.whyCN: 言语同时是人类行为与人类传承，因此它能被同一个既管亲属又管工具的叙述收进来。

senses.title: Fieldwork as method
senses.titleCN: 田野工作：长期驻留与参与观察
senses.definition: the practice of living among people for a long period in order to observe them
senses.definitionCN: 长期生活于研究对象之中以进行观察的实践
senses.example: Anthropology is taught through fieldwork, not only through reading.
senses.exampleCN: 人类学通过田野工作来教，而不只靠阅读。
senses.why: If the aim is the whole of a way of life, no questionnaire can deliver it; residence is the instrument, which is why the discipline's method became its identity.
senses.whyCN: 如果目标是生活方式的整体，问卷无法给出；驻留才是仪器，因此方法本身成了这门学科的标识。

senses.title: An anthropology of a topic
senses.titleCN: 某一主题的人类学：对某个领域的比较性论述
senses.definition: a comparative, ethnographically grounded account of one domain, such as money or food
senses.definitionCN: 对某一领域（如货币、食物）作的比较性、基于田野的论述
senses.example: The book offers an anthropology of debt rather than an economic history.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书提供的是关于债务的人类学论述，而不是经济史。
senses.why: Once the word named the whole account, it could be borrowed by parts: an anthropology of X is the slice of that account which a topic deserves.
senses.whyCN: 当这个词指称整体叙述之后，各部分便可借用它：某一主题的人类学，就是整体叙述中该主题应得的那一片。

senses.title: Applied anthropology
senses.titleCN: 应用人类学：把学科方法用于政策与实践
senses.definition: the use of anthropological methods to solve practical problems outside academia
senses.definitionCN: 把人类学方法用于学界之外的现实问题
senses.example: Applied anthropology placed a researcher inside the hospital's design team.
senses.exampleCN: 应用人类学把研究者安排进医院的设计团队。
senses.why: Comparison teaches that arrangements taken as natural are made; that knowledge is useful whenever an institution wants to change behaviour.
senses.whyCN: 比较让人看到，被当作自然的安排其实是被做出来的；只要机构想改变行为，这种知识就有用。

senses.title: Philosophical anthropology
senses.titleCN: 哲学人类学：追问「人是什么」
senses.definition: the philosophical inquiry into what kind of being a human is
senses.definitionCN: 从哲学上追问人属于何种存在
senses.example: Philosophical anthropology asks what a person is, not how a village works.
senses.exampleCN: 哲学人类学问的是人是什么，而不是村庄如何运转。
senses.why: The Greek word began as an account of the human being as such; the older question survives beside the empirical discipline, stripped of fieldwork.
senses.whyCN: 这个希腊词起初就是对「人本身」的论述；那个更古老的问题与经验学科并存，只是不再带田野。

intro.en: Anthropology is a Greek compound that reached English through Renaissance Latin, and the status of its first element is the one open question in an otherwise clear history.
intro.cn: anthropology 是经文艺复兴拉丁语进入英语的希腊语复合词；在其余清楚的历史里，唯一悬而未决的是第一个成分的来源。

items.en: Anthropos 'human being' is attested from early Greek, but its internal make-up is disputed. One hypothesis reads it as aner 'man' plus ops 'face, eye'; that reading is a conjecture, and no accepted derivation exists.
items.cn: anthropos「人」自早期希腊语即有书证，但其内部构造有争议。一种假说把它读作 anēr「男人」加 ōps「脸、眼」；这只是推测，并无公认的派生。

items.en: -Logia 'account, study' comes from logos 'word, reason', built on legein 'to gather, say'. The Indo-European root behind legein is a reconstruction.
items.cn: -logia「叙述、学问」出自 logos「言词、理性」，由 legein「收集、说出」构成。legein 背后的印欧词根为重构。

items.en: Renaissance scholars formed anthropologia on the Greek model, and the word was used for discourse about human nature before it named a field.
items.cn: 文艺复兴学者依希腊模式造出 anthropologia，在它指称学科之前，该词用于关于人性的论述。

items.en: English anthropology appears in the sixteenth century in the sense of speaking about the human being; the modern discipline took shape in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 英语 anthropology 于 16 世纪出现，意为关于人的言说；现代学科形态在 19 世纪成形。

items.en: American anthropology settled into four fields, cultural, biological, linguistic and archaeological, while British usage kept social anthropology as the central name.
items.cn: 美国人类学定型为文化、生物、语言、考古四分支，而英国用法仍以社会人类学为核心名称。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the make-up of anthropos has no agreed analysis, and every pre-Greek form proposed for it is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：anthropos 的内部构造没有一致分析，凡为其拟出的前希腊语形式均属重构。

note.en: Group one holds words built on the same Greek stem or mistaken for the discipline; group two holds neighbouring fields that also study people.
note.cn: 第一组是同出希腊词干、或常被误认为本学科的词；第二组是同样研究人的邻近学科。

entries.definition: The relational adjective of anthropology; it describes work or a view, not the field.
entries.definitionCN: 人类学的关系形容词；描述研究或视角，而非学科本身。

entries.definition: The practitioner of the discipline; a person, not the body of study.
entries.definitionCN: 该学科的从业者；是人，不是学问总体。

entries.definition: Built on the same stem with -oid 'resembling': man-like, used mainly of apes.
entries.definitionCN: 同词干加 -oid「形似」：像人的，多用于猿类。

entries.definition: Mis- 'hate' plus anthropos: dislike of human beings, the reverse of philanthropy.
entries.definitionCN: mis-「恨」加 anthropos：厌恶人类，与 philanthropy 相反。

entries.definition: The study of societies, usually by statistical and institutional methods rather than by fieldwork comparison.
entries.definitionCN: 研究社会的学问，通常以统计与制度方法为主，而非田野比较。

entries.definition: The older comparative study of peoples and cultures, often contrasted with ethnography, the description of one case.
entries.definitionCN: 较早的族群与文化比较研究，常与描述单一案例的 ethnography 相对。

entries.definition: The description of a single people or setting, the core method and product of social anthropology.
entries.definitionCN: 对单一族群或场景的描述，是社会人类学的核心方法与成品。

entries.definition: The branches of learning that study human expression; it shares the topic but not the method or the Greek stem.
entries.definitionCN: 研究人类表达的各人文学科；主题相同，但方法与希腊词干都不同。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real branch names and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实分支名与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: anthropos 'human' + -logia 'account': the whole account of humans.
normal.cn: anthropos「人」+ -logia「叙述」：关于人的整套叙述。

normal.en: The four fields are culture, biology, language and the material record.
normal.cn: 四大分支是文化、生物、语言与物质记录。

normal.en: The family runs anthropology, anthropological, anthropologist, anthropoid, anthropocentric, philanthropy, misanthropy.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 anthropology、anthropological、anthropologist、anthropoid、anthropocentric、philanthropy、misanthropy。

normal.en: Fieldwork is the method that made the name: live there, then write.
normal.cn: 田野是成就这个名字的方法：先住进去，再写出来。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: social anthropology, cultural anthropology, applied anthropology.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：社会人类学、文化人类学、应用人类学。

abstract.en: Picture four doors on one corridor, each opening onto the same person seen from a different side.
abstract.cn: 想象一条走廊上的四扇门，每扇都通向同一个人，只是看的那一面不同。

abstract.en: Picture a stranger who stays long enough that the village stops performing for her.
abstract.cn: 想象一个外来者住得足够久，久到村子不再为她表演。

abstract.en: Picture a mirror held up to a custom at home, so that the ordinary suddenly looks arranged.
abstract.cn: 想象一面镜子照向家乡的习俗，平常事忽然显出是被人安排出来的。

examples.en: Anthropology taught her to treat her own assumptions as one case among many.
examples.cn: 人类学教会她把自己的预设当作众多案例中的一个。

examples.en: The department united anthropology with genetics and with museum collections.
examples.cn: 该系把人类学与遗传学、博物馆藏品结合在一起。

examples.en: Modern anthropology is as likely to study a trading floor as a farming village.
examples.cn: 现代人类学既可能研究农庄，也同样可能研究交易大厅。

dict_mnemonic.text: anthropo（人）+ logy（学问）＝ 关于人的全部学问；记「四扇门：文化、体质、语言、考古」。

root: 希腊 anthrōpos「人」+ -logia「学问、叙述」，经文艺复兴拉丁 anthropologia 进入英语；anthropos 的内部构造来源不确定，将其读作「男人＋脸」仅为假说。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses fan out from one claim, that humans can be given a single account: the whole field, its social, biological, archaeological and linguistic branches, its method, its topic-by-topic use, its applied use and its philosophical remnant.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项从同一个主张展开：人可以被纳入一套叙述——整体学科、社会、生物、考古、语言四支、方法、按主题的用法、应用用法，以及残存的哲学追问。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one desk holding a field notebook, a skull cast and a recorder, with four branches starting from them.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张桌子上放着一本田野笔记、一副头骨模型与一台录音机，四条分支从这些东西出发。

branches.en: THE WHOLE CLAIM: one word claims the entire account of human beings.
branches.cn: 整体主张：一个词自称包揽关于人的全部叙述。

branches.en: TWO SIDES OF ONE PERSON: social life on one hand, bones and genes on the other.
branches.cn: 同一个人的两面：一边是社会生活，一边是骨骼与基因。

branches.en: THE DEEP PAST AND ITS INSTRUMENT: the material record, and residence as the way to reach any way of life.
branches.cn: 深过去与它的仪器：物质记录，以及以驻留接近任何生活方式的方法。

branches.en: SPEECH AS INHERITANCE: language belongs both to behaviour and to what is handed down.
branches.cn: 言语作为传承：语言既属行为，也属代代相传之物。

branches.en: BORROWED AND QUESTIONED: a topic-sized slice, a practical use, and the old question of what a person is.
branches.cn: 被借用与被追问：主题大小的切片、实践中的用途，以及「人是什么」的老问题。

intro.en: Anthropology is a Greek prefix-root compound with a Greek suffix, and the same two elements also build several English words outside the discipline.
intro.cn: anthropology 是希腊语前缀词根加希腊语后缀的复合词，这两个成分还在学科之外构成若干英语词。

latinIntro.en: Greek anthropos 'human being' supplies the first element; Greek -logia 'account' supplies the second. Latin contributes the Renaissance wrapper anthropologia but no root of its own.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊 anthropos「人」提供前件；希腊 -logia「叙述」提供后件。拉丁语只提供了文艺复兴的外壳 anthropologia，并无自身词根。

items.example: The anthropo- element also appears in anthropoid and anthropometry.
items.exampleCN: anthropo- 这一成分也出现在 anthropoid 与 anthropometry 中。

items.example: The same suffix builds biology and ecology.
items.exampleCN: 同一后缀构成 biology 与 ecology。

items.example: Anthropology is the widest of the human sciences.
items.exampleCN: 人类学是诸人文科学中最宽的一门。

items.example: The question was framed in anthropological terms.
items.exampleCN: 这个问题以人类学的措辞提出。

items.example: The anthropologist spent two years in the village.
items.exampleCN: 这位人类学家在村里住了两年。

items.example: The anthropoid ape lacks a human larynx.
items.exampleCN: 类人猿没有人的喉部结构。

items.example: The charge of being anthropocentric is common in ecology.
items.exampleCN: 生态学中常有「以人类为中心」的指责。

items.example: Philanthropy funded the new clinic.
items.exampleCN: 慈善捐助建起了新诊所。

items.example: His misanthropy grew with each election.
items.exampleCN: 他的厌世随每一次选举加深。

latinEntries.structure: anthropologia, -ae (New Latin, f., first declension, from Greek)
anthropos (Greek noun, m., borrowed unchanged in learned Latin)

definition_zh: 人类学的；与人类学研究或比较视角有关的
definition_en: relating to anthropology or to its comparative study of human life
core_image: 一副看得很近又退得很远的眼镜：近到能看清一顿饭的规矩，远到能把几个社会并排放在一页上
scene: 研究者先把自家饭桌上的规矩写成问题，再带到别处对照。The team framed the question in anthropological terms, asking how a gift carries an obligation.
sceneCN: 这里「人类学的」指采用该学科的比较视角来提问（第 5 个义项：比较视角）；句意为团队以人类学的措辞提出问题，追问一件礼物如何带着一份义务。

pos.zh: 人类学的；属于人类学研究或视角的

derivatives.zh: anthropological 的名词基座：anthropo-（希腊「人」）+ -logy（希腊「学问」）→ 人类学
anthropological + -ly（副词后缀）→ 从人类学角度
anthropology + -ist → 人类学家
anthropo- + morphē（希腊「形状」）+ -ize → 赋予非人事物人的形态（语义偏移：把人的形状套到别处）
phil-（爱）+ anthrōpos（人）+ -ic → 慈善的（语义偏移：爱人的）

senses.title: Belonging to the discipline
senses.titleCN: 属于这门学科：由人类学提出的
senses.definition: produced by or belonging to the academic field of anthropology
senses.definitionCN: 由人类学学科产生或属于该学科的
senses.example: The team framed the question in anthropological terms, asking how a gift carries an obligation.
senses.exampleCN: 团队以人类学的措辞提出问题，追问一件礼物如何带着一份义务。
senses.why: The suffix -ical turns the field name into a relational adjective; it marks provenance, saying which workshop the work came out of.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ical 把学科名变成关系形容词；它标记出身，说明这项工作出自哪间作坊。

senses.title: About human beings in general
senses.titleCN: 关于人的：以人为对象的一般属性
senses.definition: concerning human beings as a species rather than one society
senses.definitionCN: 涉及作为物种的人，而非某一社会
senses.example: The famine has an anthropological dimension that economics alone misses.
senses.exampleCN: 这场饥荒有一个单靠经济学看不到的人类学维度。
senses.why: Because the Greek stem means simply 'human being', the adjective can widen beyond the department to anything that concerns humans as such.
senses.whyCN: 由于希腊词干本义就是「人」，这个形容词可以越出系科，指向任何以人本身为对象的事物。

senses.title: Of fieldwork method
senses.titleCN: 田野方法的：靠长期驻留与参与观察得来的
senses.definition: obtained by long residence and participant observation rather than by survey
senses.definitionCN: 通过长期驻留与参与观察而非问卷获得
senses.example: Her evidence is anthropological in the strict sense: two years of notes from one street.
senses.exampleCN: 她的证据是严格意义上的人类学的：来自一条街的两年笔记。
senses.why: Method lends its name to the adjective: work done by living among people is called anthropological even when its topic is not the discipline itself.
senses.whyCN: 方法把自己的名字借给形容词：靠住在人群里做出的研究，即使题目不属于该学科，也叫人类学的。

senses.title: Of human biology and evolution
senses.titleCN: 体质与演化的：涉及骨骼、基因与化石
senses.definition: relating to the biological study of humans, their growth and their fossil record
senses.definitionCN: 涉及人类的生物学研究、生长与化石记录
senses.example: An anthropological measurement of the jaw can date the change in diet.
senses.exampleCN: 对下颌的人类学测量可以给饮食变化定年。
senses.why: The four-field shape of the discipline left one field holding bones, so the adjective also covers the body and its deep history.
senses.whyCN: 学科的四分支格局让其中一支掌管骨骼，因此这个形容词也覆盖身体及其深历史。

senses.title: The comparative perspective
senses.titleCN: 比较视角：把自家习惯当作众多案例之一
senses.definition: characteristic of the comparative view that treats every way of life as one case among many
senses.definitionCN: 体现把每种生活方式都视为众多案例之一的比较眼光
senses.example: The most anthropological thing in the room was the question, not the answer.
senses.exampleCN: 屋里最具人类学意味的是那个问题，而不是答案。
senses.why: Comparison was the discipline's founding gesture, so the adjective came to name a habit of mind: stand back far enough to see your own rules as choices.
senses.whyCN: 比较是这门学科的立身动作，于是这个形容词也指一种思维习惯：退得够远，看出自己的规矩只是选择之一。

senses.title: Of human nature, philosophically
senses.titleCN: 人性论的：追问人作为人是什么
senses.definition: relating to philosophical inquiry into what a human being essentially is
senses.definitionCN: 涉及对人本质上是什么的哲学追问
senses.example: The old anthropological question returns whenever a machine is said to think.
senses.exampleCN: 每当有人说机器会思考，那个古老的人类学问题就又回来了。
senses.why: Before the word named a field it named discourse about human nature; the adjective kept that older, philosophical layer alive.
senses.whyCN: 在这个词指称学科之前，它指关于人性的论述；形容词把那一层更古老的哲学含义保留了下来。

senses.title: Of the long record
senses.titleCN: 长时段记录的：以千年尺度看人的痕迹
senses.definition: relating to the long timescale of the human record, from fossils to written traces
senses.definitionCN: 涉及从化石到文字痕迹的千年尺度人类记录
senses.example: Climate change looks different when seen through an anthropological lens.
senses.exampleCN: 透过人类学的镜头，气候变化看起来不一样。
senses.why: A discipline that reads fossils and fieldnotes together necessarily works in deep time, and the adjective carries that span into other debates.
senses.whyCN: 一门同时读化石与田野笔记的学科必然在深时间中工作，形容词把这段跨度带进别的争论。

senses.title: Applied to practical decisions
senses.titleCN: 用于实际决策：为设计、政策与医疗提供依据
senses.definition: used to inform design, policy or health practice with comparative knowledge of users
senses.definitionCN: 以关于使用者的比较知识支持设计、政策或医疗实践
senses.example: The hospital hired her for anthropological advice on why patients ignored the forms.
senses.exampleCN: 医院请她提供人类学建议，解释病人为何不看那些表格。
senses.why: Since comparison shows that routines are made, the adjective can label the use of that knowledge by anyone who wants to remake a routine.
senses.whyCN: 既然比较显示惯例是被做出来的，这个形容词便可标记任何想重造惯例者对这类知识的使用。

intro.en: The adjective adds a Latin-derived ending to a Greek compound; the ending is clear, while the Greek stem it attaches to is not.
intro.cn: 这个形容词在希腊复合词后加了一个拉丁来源的词尾；词尾清楚，它所附着的希腊词干则不然。

items.en: Anthropos 'human being' has early attestation, but its internal analysis is disputed; the reading as aner 'man' plus ops 'face' is a hypothesis, not an accepted derivation.
items.cn: anthropos「人」书证很早，但内部构造有争议；读作 anēr「男人」加 ōps「脸」只是假说，并非公认派生。

items.en: -Logia 'account, study' goes back to logos 'word, reason' and legein 'to gather, say'; the Indo-European root involved is reconstructed.
items.cn: -logia「叙述、学问」溯至 logos「言词、理性」与 legein「收集、说出」；涉及的印欧词根为重构。

items.en: Renaissance Latin formed anthropologia, which passed into French and then English as the name of a field of discourse.
items.cn: 文艺复兴拉丁语造出 anthropologia，经法语进入英语，指一类论述的名称。

items.en: The relational ending came through Latin -alis and French -al, and English added -ical to make the adjective of a long noun; the pattern is the same as in biological and geological.
items.cn: 关系词尾经拉丁 -alis 与法语 -al 而来，英语再加 -ical 构成长名词的形容词；biological、geological 同理。

items.en: The adjective became common only when anthropology became a university subject, since a field needs a word for work that belongs to it.
items.cn: 这个形容词到人类学成为大学学科后才普遍使用，因为一门学科需要有一个词来指「属于它的工作」。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the analysis of anthropos remains unsettled, and pre-Greek forms proposed for it are reconstructions.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：anthropos 的构造仍无定论，为其拟出的前希腊语形式均为重构。

note.en: Group one holds same-stem look-alikes that differ in part of speech or meaning; group two holds adjectives from adjacent ways of studying people.
note.cn: 第一组是同词干、但词性或含义不同的形近词；第二组是邻近研究方式产出的形容词。

entries.definition: The field itself; the adjective describes work belonging to it.
entries.definitionCN: 学科本身；形容词描述属于它的工作。

entries.definition: A practitioner of the field, not a quality of work.
entries.definitionCN: 该学科的从业者，而非工作的性质。

entries.definition: Built on anthropos with -ic: concerning humans as observers, as in the anthropic principle in cosmology.
entries.definitionCN: 同词干加 -ic：关于作为观察者的人，如宇宙学的人择原理。

entries.definition: Man-like in form, used of apes and robots; it says nothing about a discipline.
entries.definitionCN: 形状像人的，用于猿与机器人；与学科无关。

entries.definition: Relating to the description of a single people or setting, the classic product of the field.
entries.definitionCN: 关于对单一族群或场景的描述，是该学科的经典成品。

entries.definition: Relating to the study of societies by institutional and quantitative means.
entries.definitionCN: 以制度与量化手段研究社会的。

entries.definition: Relating to the shared habits of a group; the adjective names a subject matter, not a way of working.
entries.definitionCN: 关于群体共享习惯的；它命名题材，而非工作方式。

entries.definition: Relating to comparison across cases; anthropological work is usually comparative, but the words are not interchangeable.
entries.definitionCN: 关于跨案例比较的；人类学工作通常比较，但两词不可互换。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real relatives and real fixed phrases, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实同族词与真实搭配，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: -ical is the ending that turns a long field name into an adjective, as in biological and geological.
normal.cn: -ical 是把长学科名变成形容词的词尾，biological、geological 同理。

normal.en: The stem is anthropos 'human', so the adjective can mean 'about humans' as well as 'about the department'.
normal.cn: 词干是 anthropos「人」，因此形容词既可指「关于人类学系」，也可指「关于人」。

normal.en: The family runs anthropology, anthropological, anthropologist, anthropologically, anthropoid, anthropic.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 anthropology、anthropological、anthropologist、anthropologically、anthropoid、anthropic。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: anthropological research, anthropological perspective, anthropological fieldwork.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：人类学研究、人类学视角、人类学田野工作。

normal.en: The comparative stance is the adjective's real content: your normal is one case among many.
normal.cn: 比较姿态才是这个形容词的实质：你的正常只是众多案例之一。

abstract.en: Picture glasses that focus on a dinner table and also show four other tables in the same frame.
abstract.cn: 想象一副眼镜既看清一张饭桌，又同框显出另外四张桌子。

abstract.en: Picture a customs officer asking not what you carry but why you think it is yours.
abstract.cn: 想象一位海关官员不问带了什么，而问你凭什么认为那是你的。

abstract.en: Picture the word standing at the door of a department, pointing back at the room it came from.
abstract.cn: 想象这个词站在系科门口，回指着它出来的那个房间。

examples.en: The anthropological literature on gift exchange is larger than most economists expect.
examples.cn: 关于礼物交换的人类学文献比多数经济学家想象的更庞大。

examples.en: Her anthropological approach was to sit through every meeting without speaking.
examples.cn: 她的人类学方法是全程旁听每场会议而不发言。

examples.en: What looks like a technical choice is often an anthropological one about who counts as a person.
examples.cn: 看似技术性的选择，常常是关于谁算作人的一种人类学选择。

dict_mnemonic.text: anthropo（人）+ logical（学问的）＝ 人类学的；记「近看一顿饭，远放五张桌」。

root: 希腊 anthrōpos「人」+ -logia「学问」，经新拉丁 anthropologia 与拉丁关系词尾 -alis 构成；anthropos 的内部构造来源不确定，读作「男人＋脸」仅为假说。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses run from provenance to perspective: work from the field, work about humans generally, work by its method, work on the body, a comparative habit of mind, an older philosophical question, a deep timescale and a practical use.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从出身走到视角：出自该学科的工作、关于一般人的工作、以田野方法做的工作、关于身体的工作、比较的思维习惯、更古老的哲学问题、深时间尺度，以及实践中的用途。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: glasses that focus closely on one table and still hold five other tables in view.
core.cn: 核心意象：一副既聚焦一张桌子、又把另外五张收进视野的眼镜。

branches.en: PROVENANCE: the ending marks which workshop the work came out of.
branches.cn: 出身：词尾标记这项工作出自哪间作坊。

branches.en: TWO WIDENINGS: from one society to the species, and from culture to bones.
branches.cn: 两次放宽：从一个社会到整个物种，从文化到骨骼。

branches.en: THE INSTRUMENT: residence gives the adjective its strictest sense.
branches.cn: 仪器：驻留给了这个形容词最严格的含义。

branches.en: THE LONG VIEW: comparison in space, and the millennium-scale record in time.
branches.cn: 长视：空间上的比较，与时间上的千年尺度记录。

branches.en: OLD QUESTION, NEW USE: what a person is, and what that knowledge does in a ward.
branches.cn: 老问题与新用途：人是什么，以及这类知识在病房里能做什么。

intro.en: The adjective is a Greek stem with two layers of ending, one Latin and one English, which is why it looks longer than the noun.
intro.cn: 这个形容词是希腊词干加两层词尾，一层拉丁、一层英语，所以看起来比名词更长。

latinIntro.en: Greek anthropos and -logia build the noun base; Latin -alis and English -ical build the adjective. Latin contributes no root of its own here.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊 anthropos 与 -logia 构成名词基座；拉丁 -alis 与英语 -ical 构成形容词。拉丁语在此没有自身词根。

items.example: The anthropo- element also builds anthropoid.
items.exampleCN: anthropo- 也构成 anthropoid。

items.example: The suffix is shared with biology.
items.exampleCN: 该后缀与 biology 共用。

items.example: The ending turns a long noun into a relational adjective.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾把长名词变成关系形容词。

items.example: The anthropological question came before the anthropological answer.
items.exampleCN: 人类学的问题先于人类学的答案。

items.example: The practice is anthropologically ordinary.
items.exampleCN: 这种做法从人类学看很平常。

items.example: The anthropologist wrote nothing for two years.
items.exampleCN: 这位人类学家两年没写东西。

items.meaningCN: 关于作为观察者的人的
items.example: The anthropic argument is debated in cosmology.
items.exampleCN: 人择论证在宇宙学中有争议。

items.example: Anthropoid robots copy the human hand.
items.exampleCN: 类人机器人模仿人的手。

items.meaning: relating to the comparison of peoples
items.example: The two adjectives are often confused in older texts.
items.exampleCN: 旧文献中这两个形容词常被混淆。

latinEntries.structure: anthropologia, -ae (New Latin, f., first declension, from Greek)
anthropos (Greek noun, m., borrowed unchanged in learned Latin)
ethnologia, -ae (New Latin, f., first declension, from Greek ethnos 'people')

definition_zh: 人类学家；以田野比较方式研究人类社会与文化的学者
definition_en: a scholar who studies human societies and cultures, usually through fieldwork and comparison
core_image: 一个人背着笔记本在村口蹲下，先学会当地人的称呼，再开始记录
scene: 村口晒谷场边，外来者跟着主人学插秧，笔记本一直没打开。The anthropologist lived in the village for two years before writing a single line about it.
sceneCN: 这里指「以长期田野方式研究人类社会的学者」（第 2 个义项：田野工作者）；句意为这位人类学家在村里住了两年，才写下关于它的第一行字。

pos.zh: 人类学家（可数名词，复数为 anthropologists）

derivatives.zh: anthropologist 的学科基座：anthropo-（希腊「人」）+ -logy（希腊「学问」）→ 人类学
anthropology + -ical → 人类学的
ethno-（希腊 ethnos「族群」）+ -logist（研究者）→ 族群研究者（语义偏移：以族群比较为业，而非以整个学科为业）
socio-（拉丁 socius「同伴」）+ -logist → 社会学家（语义偏移：以制度与统计为主）

senses.title: A practitioner of the discipline
senses.titleCN: 学科从业者：以人类学为业的人
senses.definition: a person who works professionally in anthropology
senses.definitionCN: 以人类学为职业的人
senses.example: The anthropologist lived in the village for two years before writing a single line about it.
senses.exampleCN: 这位人类学家在村里住了两年，才写下关于它的第一行字。
senses.why: -ist is the agent ending: it names the person who does what the field name describes, exactly as biologist names the person who does biology.
senses.whyCN: -ist 是施动者词尾：它指做那门学问所述之事的人，正如 biologist 指做 biology 的人。

senses.title: A fieldworker
senses.titleCN: 田野工作者：住在研究对象中间做参与观察的人
senses.definition: one who lives among a group for a long period and takes part in daily life
senses.definitionCN: 长期住在研究对象之中并参与日常生活的人
senses.example: As a fieldworker she was an anthropologist first and a writer second.
senses.exampleCN: 作为田野工作者，她首先是人类学家，其次才是写作者。
senses.why: Since residence is the discipline's instrument, the person holding it is identified with the instrument; the job title and the method became one word.
senses.whyCN: 既然驻留是这门学科的仪器，掌仪器的人就与仪器合称；职称与方法于是成了同一个词。

senses.title: A university researcher and teacher
senses.titleCN: 大学研究者与教师：授课、指导、发表
senses.definition: a scholar employed to research and teach the subject in a university
senses.definitionCN: 受雇在大学研究与教授该学科的人
senses.example: The anthropologist supervised six doctoral students and taught one survey course.
senses.exampleCN: 这位人类学家指导六名博士生，并讲授一门概览课。
senses.why: Once the field entered universities, the practitioner acquired a second identity: salaried researcher, examiner and supervisor, with obligations the fieldworker did not have.
senses.whyCN: 学科进入大学之后，从业者又多了第二重身份：领薪的研究者、考官与导师，负田野工作者所没有的义务。

senses.title: A subfield specialist
senses.titleCN: 分支专家：以某一分支为专长
senses.definition: a specialist in one branch, such as biological or linguistic anthropology
senses.definitionCN: 以生物、语言等某一分支为专长的人
senses.example: A biological anthropologist identified the species from a single tooth.
senses.exampleCN: 一位生物人类学家凭一颗牙确定了物种。
senses.why: As the four fields grew apart, the plain title had to be qualified; the specialist is still an anthropologist, but the adjective tells you which corner of the workshop.
senses.whyCN: 四分支渐行渐远，朴素的头衔必须加限定；分支专家仍是人类学家，只是形容词告诉你他占作坊的哪个角落。

senses.title: A consultant or expert witness
senses.titleCN: 顾问或专家证人：为机构与法庭提供判断
senses.definition: one who applies the discipline's knowledge for an institution, court or agency
senses.definitionCN: 为机构、法庭或政府部门运用本学科知识的人
senses.example: The anthropologist advised the court on how the community understood the disputed land.
senses.exampleCN: 这位人类学家就社区如何理解争议土地向法庭提供意见。
senses.why: Because the discipline can describe how a group assigns rights and meanings, its practitioner became a person whose testimony carries weight outside the campus.
senses.whyCN: 由于这门学问能描述一个群体如何分配权利与意义，其从业者就成了在校园之外说话有分量的人。

senses.title: An author of a monograph
senses.titleCN: 民族志专著的作者：把田野写成书
senses.definition: the writer of the book-length account that fieldwork eventually produces
senses.definitionCN: 把田野工作最终写成整本书的人
senses.example: The anthropologist rewrote the monograph three times to avoid speaking for the villagers.
senses.exampleCN: 这位人类学家把专著改了三遍，以免替村民说话。
senses.why: The discipline's typical product is a book about one case; the person who makes that book is named by the same title, since writing is how the work becomes knowledge.
senses.whyCN: 这门学科的典型成品是一本关于单一案例的书；写出这本书的人用同一个头衔称呼，因为写作正是工作变成知识的方式。

senses.title: A member of a field team
senses.titleCN: 田野团队一员：在合作项目里承担观察
senses.definition: one member of a team observing an event, often for a design or health project
senses.definitionCN: 在合作项目中承担现场观察的一员
senses.example: The anthropologist on the team recorded how nurses actually handed over shifts.
senses.exampleCN: 团队里的这位人类学家记录了护士实际如何交接班。
senses.why: Modern projects hire the title for a role rather than a career: someone who watches the real practice beside the official one.
senses.whyCN: 现代项目雇的是这个头衔所指的角色，而非终身职业：一个在官方做法旁观察真实做法的人。

senses.title: A public interpreter of culture
senses.titleCN: 公共阐释者：向大众解释文化差异
senses.definition: one who explains cultural difference to a general audience through books, film or commentary
senses.definitionCN: 通过书籍、影像或评论向大众解释文化差异的人
senses.example: The anthropologist's radio essays made the town's ritual intelligible to outsiders.
senses.exampleCN: 这位人类学家的广播随笔让外人听懂了小镇的仪式。
senses.why: -ist also names a public identity: whoever speaks for the field in public carries the title, whether or not they are currently in the field.
senses.whyCN: -ist 也指一种公共身份：在公共场合代表该学科发言的人就带着这个头衔，无论当下是否在田野。

intro.en: The noun is the field name plus the agent ending -ist, and its only unsettled part is the Greek stem inside the field name.
intro.cn: 这个名词是学科名加施动词尾 -ist 构成，唯一未定的部分是学科名里的希腊词干。

items.en: Anthropos 'human being' is early and common, but its internal analysis is disputed; the aner plus ops reading is a hypothesis, and no accepted derivation exists.
items.cn: anthropos「人」出现早且常见，但内部构造有争议；「anēr 加 ōps」的读法只是假说，并无公认派生。

items.en: -Logia 'account, study' derives from logos 'word, reason' and legein 'to gather, say'; the deeper Indo-European root is reconstructed.
items.cn: -logia「叙述、学问」出自 logos「言词、理性」与 legein「收集、说出」；更深的印欧词根为重构。

items.en: Renaissance Latin anthropologia named discourse about the human being and supplied the base for the modern field name.
items.cn: 文艺复兴拉丁语 anthropologia 指关于人的论述，为现代学科名提供了基座。

items.en: The ending reached English through French -iste and Latin -ista, from Greek -istes, and it marks the person devoted to whatever the stem names.
items.cn: 该词尾经法语 -iste、拉丁 -ista，源自希腊 -istes 进入英语，标记专注于词干所述之事的人。

items.en: Anthropologist became a job title only when the field acquired university posts and expeditions, in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: anthropologist 到 19 世纪该学科有了大学职位与考察队之后，才成为职业头衔。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the make-up of anthropos remains unsettled, and all pre-Greek forms proposed for it are reconstructions.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：anthropos 的构造仍无定论，为其拟出的前希腊语形式均为重构。

note.en: Group one holds the same-stem words most often swapped for the person; group two holds neighbouring specialists.
note.cn: 第一组是最常与人称互换的同词干词；第二组是相邻的专门研究者。

entries.definition: The discipline itself; the person is named by adding the agent ending.
entries.definitionCN: 学科本身；指人需加施动词尾。

entries.definition: Describes work or a view belonging to the field, not a person.
entries.definitionCN: 描述属于该学科的工作或视角，而非人。

entries.definition: Man-like in form, said of apes; it shares the stem but not the occupation.
entries.definitionCN: 形状像人的，用于猿类；共享词干，但无关职业。

entries.definition: Phil- 'love' plus anthropos plus -ist: a giver to good causes, not a student of humans.
entries.definitionCN: phil-「爱」加 anthropos 加 -ist：行善捐助者，而非研究人的人。

entries.definition: One who writes the description of a single people; often the same person under a method-focused name.
entries.definitionCN: 写出单一族群描述的人；常是同一人的方法论称谓。

entries.definition: One who compares peoples and cultures rather than describing one case.
entries.definitionCN: 比较各族群与文化、而非描述单一案例的人。

entries.definition: One who studies societies mainly through institutions, surveys and statistics.
entries.definitionCN: 主要通过制度、调查与统计研究社会的人。

entries.definition: One who studies past life through objects and layers; a colleague, not the same job.
entries.definitionCN: 通过器物与地层研究过去生活的人；是同行，但非同一职业。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real relatives and real fixed phrases, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实同族词与真实搭配，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: -ist marks the person, exactly as in biologist and geologist.
normal.cn: -ist 标记人，与 biologist、geologist 完全同理。

normal.en: The person is named after the instrument: someone who lives among people long enough to compare.
normal.cn: 此人以仪器得名：住得够久、得以比较的人。

normal.en: The family runs anthropology, anthropological, anthropologist, ethnologist, sociologist, archaeologist.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 anthropology、anthropological、anthropologist、ethnologist、sociologist、archaeologist。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: cultural anthropologist, biological anthropologist, a team of anthropologists.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：文化人类学家、生物人类学家、人类学家团队。

normal.en: The title travels: campus, courtroom, clinic, radio studio.
normal.cn: 这个头衔会走动：校园、法庭、诊所、广播间。

abstract.en: Picture someone who learns the local word for 'we' before learning the word for 'I'.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人先学会当地话里的「我们」，再学会「我」。

abstract.en: Picture a notebook thick enough that the village can be heard through it.
abstract.cn: 想象一本厚得能从中听见村子的笔记。

abstract.en: Picture a person standing between two rooms, refusing to declare either one normal.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人站在两个房间之间，拒绝宣布哪一间才正常。

examples.en: The anthropologist refused to generalise from one village to a whole country.
examples.cn: 这位人类学家拒绝从一个村庄推及整个国家。

examples.en: An anthropologist was hired to observe how the new queue actually worked.
examples.cn: 一位人类学家受聘观察新排队方式的实际运作。

examples.en: Historians and anthropologists read the same letters for different things.
examples.cn: 历史学家与人类学家从同一批信件里读不同的东西。

dict_mnemonic.text: anthropo（人）+ logist（研究者）＝ 研究人的人；记「先在村里住两年，再写第一行」。

root: 希腊 anthrōpos「人」+ -logia「学问」+ 希腊 -istēs（经拉丁 -ista、法语 -iste）施动词尾；anthropos 的内部构造来源不确定，读作「男人＋脸」仅为假说。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one person through changing roles: practitioner, fieldworker, salaried teacher, subfield specialist, witness for institutions, author, team observer and public voice.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项跟着同一个人走过不同角色：从业者、田野工作者、领薪教师、分支专家、为机构作证者、著书者、团队观察者与公共发声者。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person crouches at the village gate with a notebook, having learned the local names first.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人抱着笔记本蹲在村口，先学会了当地的称呼。

branches.en: PERSON AND METHOD: the title names whoever does the field's work, and the work is residence.
branches.cn: 人与方法：头衔指做这门学问之事的人，而那件事就是驻留。

branches.en: THE CAMPUS: salary, students and examinations add duties the fieldworker never had.
branches.cn: 校园：薪水、学生与考试加进了田野工作者从未有的义务。

branches.en: NARROWING AND TEAMWORK: a branch adjective narrows the title, and a project hires it for a role.
branches.cn: 收窄与协作：分支形容词收窄头衔，项目则按角色雇用它。

branches.en: OUTSIDE AND AFTER: testimony in a court, and the book that turns notes into knowledge.
branches.cn: 在外与之后：法庭上的证词，以及把笔记变成知识的书。

branches.en: THE PUBLIC VOICE: whoever speaks for the field in public carries the title too.
branches.cn: 公共之声：在公共场合代表该学科发言的人同样带着这个头衔。

intro.en: The noun is a Greek compound plus a Greek agent ending filtered through Latin and French, and the same pieces build several near neighbours.
intro.cn: 这个名词是希腊复合词加希腊施动词尾，经拉丁语与法语过滤而成，同样几个部件还构成若干近邻词。

latinIntro.en: Greek anthropos and -logia form the base; Greek -istes, Latin -ista and French -iste form the ending. Latin supplies no root here.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊 anthropos 与 -logia 构成基座；希腊 -istēs、拉丁 -ista 与法语 -iste 构成词尾。拉丁语在此不提供词根。

items.example: The anthropo- element also builds philanthropy.
items.exampleCN: anthropo- 也构成 philanthropy。

items.example: The suffix builds anthropology and biology alike.
items.exampleCN: 该后缀同样构成 anthropology 与 biology。

items.example: The ending marks the doer of the stem's activity.
items.exampleCN: 该词尾标记词干活动的施行者。

items.example: Anthropology supplies the name the person carries.
items.exampleCN: 人类学提供此人所带的名称。

items.example: The anthropologist kept two sets of notes.
items.exampleCN: 这位人类学家记了两套笔记。

items.example: The report was anthropological in method only.
items.exampleCN: 这份报告只在方法上是人类学的。

items.example: The ethnologist compared burial customs across five regions.
items.exampleCN: 这位族群研究者比较了五个地区的丧葬习俗。

items.example: A philanthropist paid for the archive's roof.
items.exampleCN: 一位慈善家出资修了档案馆的屋顶。

items.example: The sociologist worked from tax records, not fieldnotes.
items.exampleCN: 这位社会学家依据税务记录，而非田野笔记。

anthropos (Greek noun, m., borrowed unchanged in learned Latin)
